newsitem.title: PERU: Peru's June agriculture growth up 3 pct vs yr ago.
newsitem.headline: Peru's June agriculture growth up 3 pct vs yr ago.

text.p: Peru's agricultural sector expanded 3.0 percent year-over-year in June, compared with the same month of 1996, official daily El Peruano said Tuesday.
The agriculture sector also registered an 8.2 percent economic expansion year-over-year in the first half of 1997, El Peruano added, citing agriculture ministry officials.
Overall the economy is expected to show year-over-year growth of more than seven percent in June 1997, according to analysts. That would compare to 5.1 percent growth in the same month last year.
The June 1997 growth figure -- to be published later Tuesday -- is expected to be led by the construction sector, analysts said.
The economy's cumulative year-over-year growth in the first five months of 1997 was 7.1 percent, compared with 1.1 percent in the same period of 1996.
The government forecasts five percent overall growth in 1997.
